playlists.description: An ordered, looping list of media items owned by a company or one branch, with its transition. Several programs may schedule the same playlist.
playlists.lifecycle: Created empty; renames, transition changes and item replacements bump the version. Deleted at runtime, with its items, only when no schedule rule or default uses it. The owning scope never changes. See docs/project/programming-design.md.

company_id.description: Company that owns the playlist; immutable (tenant key).

branch_id.description: Branch that owns the playlist; immutable.
branch_id.nullMeaning: The playlist belongs to the whole company and every member who may view programming sees it.

name.description: Display name chosen by members, trimmed, 1 to 120 characters.

updated_at.description: PostgreSQL-clock instant of the last change.

objects.playlists_company_id_fkey: A playlist belongs to an existing company.
objects.playlists_company_id_branch_id_fkey: The owning branch belongs to the same company.
objects.playlists_company_created_idx: Lists a company's playlists newest first with keyset cursors.
objects.playlists_name_trimmed: Names are trimmed and not empty.
objects.playlists_fade: A fade carries a duration from 250 to 2,000 ms and a cut carries none.

playlist_items.description: One position of a playlist: the media item it plays and, for an image, how long.
playlist_items.lifecycle: Replaced as a whole list when members save the playlist's items; deleted with the playlist (cascade inside the module). The same media item may appear at several positions.

company_id.description: Company that owns the playlist (tenant key).

media_asset_id.description: Media item played at this position.

duration_ms.description: How long an image is shown, 1,000 to 3,600,000.
duration_ms.nullMeaning: The item is a video and plays its whole duration.

objects.playlist_items_company_id_playlist_id_fk: The playlist belongs to the same company; items are deleted with it.
objects.playlist_items_company_id_media_asset_id: The media item belongs to the same company and cannot be removed while referenced.
objects.playlist_items_media_idx: Finds the playlists that use a media item, for the media reference guard.
objects.playlist_items_duration_range: Image durations stay within 1 to 3,600 seconds.

programming_groups.description: A company-owned group of screens that share one program, spanning the whole company or a fixed set of branches.
programming_groups.lifecycle: Created with its program; renames and span changes bump the version. Deleted at runtime, with its program and span rows, only when it has no member screens.

company_id.description: Company that owns the group; immutable (tenant key).

name.description: Display name, trimmed, 1 to 80 characters, unique in the company ignoring case.

all_branches.description: True when the group spans every branch of the company; otherwise programming_group_branches lists its span.

updated_at.description: PostgreSQL-clock instant of the last change.

objects.programming_groups_company_id_fkey: A group belongs to an existing company.
objects.programming_groups_company_name_unique: Group names are unique in a company, ignoring case.
objects.programming_groups_name_trimmed: Names are trimmed and not empty.

programming_group_branches.description: The explicit branch span of a group that does not cover the whole company.
programming_group_branches.lifecycle: Replaced when the group's span changes; deleted with the group (cascade inside the module). While a row names a branch, archiving that branch is refused.

company_id.description: Company that owns the group (tenant key).

group_id.description: Group whose span this row belongs to.

objects.programming_group_branches_pkey: Each branch appears once in a group's span.
objects.programming_group_branches_company_id_gr: The group belongs to the same company; rows are deleted with it.
objects.programming_group_branches_company_id_br: The branch belongs to the same company.
objects.programming_group_branches_branch_idx: Finds groups whose span names a branch, for the branch archive guard.

programs.description: The draft programming of one source: exactly one group or one screen.
programs.lifecycle: A group's program is created with the group and deleted with it (cascade inside the module); a screen's program is created when its layout or first output is saved and kept with the device record. Saving an output or choosing a layout bumps the version, and so does a layout save that removes outputs with content.

company_id.description: Company that owns the program; immutable (tenant key).

group_id.nullMeaning: The program belongs to a screen.

device_id.nullMeaning: The program belongs to a group.

layout_id.description: Layout whose areas are the program's outputs.
layout_id.nullMeaning: The program has no layout and a single screen output.

version.description: Optimistic concurrency version, starting at 1; the API reports 0 for a program not yet saved.

updated_at.description: PostgreSQL-clock instant of the last change.

objects.programs_company_id_fkey: A program belongs to an existing company.
objects.programs_company_id_group_id_fkey: The group belongs to the same company; its program is deleted with it.
objects.programs_company_id_device_id_fkey: The screen belongs to the same company.
objects.programs_group_key: A group has at most one program.
objects.programs_device_key: A screen has at most one program.
objects.programs_one_source: A program belongs to exactly one group or one screen.
objects.programs_company_id_layout_id_fkey: The layout belongs to the same company; a layout that programs use cannot be deleted.
objects.programs_layout_idx: Finds the programs that use a layout, for layout saves and deletion.

program_outputs.description: One output of a program (the full screen now; layout areas later) with its optional default playlist.
program_outputs.lifecycle: Created or updated when the output is saved; deleted with the program (cascade inside the module).

company_id.description: Company that owns the program (tenant key).

output_key.description: Output key: screen for a program without a layout, otherwise the key of one of its layout's areas.

default_playlist_id.description: Playlist shown when no schedule applies.
default_playlist_id.nullMeaning: The output shows neutral output when no schedule applies.

objects.program_outputs_company_id_program_id_fk: The program belongs to the same company; outputs are deleted with it.
objects.program_outputs_company_id_default_playl: The default playlist belongs to the same company and cannot be deleted while used.
objects.program_outputs_default_idx: Finds outputs using a playlist as default, for the playlist delete check.
objects.program_outputs_key_shape: Output keys have the area key shape: a lowercase letter, then up to 15 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens.

schedule_rules.description: A recurring local-time window that assigns a playlist to one output of a program. Rules store local values only; zones apply per screen when evaluating.
schedule_rules.lifecycle: Replaced as the whole rule set of an output when it is saved, after conflict validation; deleted with the program (cascade inside the module).

id.description: Backend-generated rule UUID, new on every save.

company_id.description: Company that owns the program (tenant key).

output_key.description: Output the rule programs: screen for a program without a layout, otherwise an area key of its layout.

position.description: Display order inside the output, 0 to 199.

weekdays.description: Bitmask of the ISO weekdays on which a window starts, bit 0 for Monday, 1 to 127.

all_day.description: True when each window covers the whole local day.

start_minute.unit: minute of the local day, 0 to 1,439

end_minute.description: Local end of the window; earlier than the start ends on the next day, 0 means the following midnight.
end_minute.unit: minute of the local day, 0 to 1,439

starts_on.description: First local date on which a window may start.

ends_on.description: Final local date, inclusive; windows clip at the midnight that ends it.
ends_on.nullMeaning: The rule has no final date.

objects.schedule_rules_company_id_program_id_fke: The program belongs to the same company; rules are deleted with it.
objects.schedule_rules_company_id_playlist_id_fk: The playlist belongs to the same company and cannot be deleted while used.
objects.schedule_rules_playlist_idx: Finds rules using a playlist, for the playlist delete check.
objects.schedule_rules_position_key: One rule per display position of an output.
objects.schedule_rules_weekdays_mask: At least one weekday and no unknown bits.
objects.schedule_rules_times: All-day rules have no times; other rules have two distinct minutes of the day.
objects.schedule_rules_dates: The final date is not before the first date.
objects.schedule_rules_key_shape: Output keys have the area key shape: a lowercase letter, then up to 15 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens.

programming_device_settings.description: A screen's programming source: its group, if any, and whether individual programming is selected.
programming_device_settings.lifecycle: Created by the first assignment; each assignment, or a move outside the group's span, updates it and bumps the version. Kept with the device record after unlinking.

company_id.description: Company that owns the screen (tenant key).

group_id.nullMeaning: The screen belongs to no group and is programmed individually.

individual.description: True when the screen uses its own program although it belongs to a group.

version.description: Optimistic concurrency version, starting at 1; the API reports 0 for a screen never assigned.

updated_at.description: PostgreSQL-clock instant of the last change.

objects.programming_device_settings_company_id_d: The screen belongs to the same company.
objects.programming_device_settings_company_id_g: The group belongs to the same company and cannot be deleted while it has members.

programming_audit_events.description: Append-only record of programming changes and assignments, with the acting member and the branches each change concerns.
programming_audit_events.lifecycle: Inserted in the same transaction as the change it records; never updated or deleted at runtime. Retention follows the company (provisional until PH-13).

subject_type.description: Kind of subject: playlist, layout, group, program or device.

subject_id.description: Playlist, layout, group, program or screen the event concerns; not a foreign key, so events outlive deleted subjects.

branch_ids.description: Branches the change concerns, for branch-scoped audit reads; empty for company-wide subjects.
branch_ids.nullMeaning: Never null; an empty array means the subject is company-wide.

actor_membership_id.description: Membership through which the change was made.

action.description: Event name such as playlist.created, playlist.items_replaced, layout.created, layout.saved, group.span_changed, program.output_replaced, program.layout_changed, program.outputs_removed, device.assignment_changed or device.left_group_on_move.

details.description: Bounded summary: names, counts, versions and IDs; never media content.

objects.programming_audit_events_company_id_fkey: An event belongs to an existing company.
objects.programming_audit_events_actor_principal: The actor is a known principal.
objects.programming_audit_events_company_id_acto: The acting membership belongs to the same company.
objects.programming_audit_events_subject_idx: Reads a subject's history newest first.
objects.programming_audit_events_branch_ids_pres: The branch list is present and bounded.
objects.programming_audit_events_subject_type: Subjects come from a closed set.

layouts.description: A reusable canvas with freeform areas, catalog views and optional coordinated pages, owned by a company or one branch.
layouts.lifecycle: Created by members or imported from its JSON representation; every save of the definition or name bumps the version. Deleted at runtime with its areas and pages. The owning scope never changes. See docs/project/catalog-composition-design.md#layouts.

company_id.description: Company that owns the layout; immutable (tenant key).

branch_id.description: Branch that owns the layout; immutable.
branch_id.nullMeaning: The layout belongs to the whole company.

name.description: Display name chosen by members, trimmed, 1 to 120 characters.

audio_mix_confirmed.description: Whether members confirmed that more than one area plays sound at once.

updated_at.description: PostgreSQL-clock instant of the last change.

objects.layouts_company_id_fkey: A layout belongs to an existing company.
objects.layouts_company_id_branch_id_fkey: The owning branch belongs to the same company.
objects.layouts_company_created_idx: Lists a company's layouts newest first with keyset cursors.
objects.layouts_name_trimmed: Names are trimmed and not empty.

layout_areas.description: One area of a layout: its rectangle in canvas units, stacking order, appearance, audio and kind, and for catalog areas the view's settings.
layout_areas.lifecycle: Replaced with the whole definition on every save, keeping each area's key; deleted with the layout.

id.description: Backend-generated area UUID, new on every save.

company_id.description: Company that owns the layout (tenant key).

key.description: Stable area key chosen by the editor, unique in the layout; program outputs refer to it.

name.description: Display name of the area, trimmed, 1 to 40 characters.

width.description: Width, at least 40 and inside the canvas.

height.description: Height, at least 40 and inside the canvas.

z.description: Stacking order, 0 to 99 and unique in the layout; higher draws above.

fit.description: How media fills the area: contain (whole, letterboxed) or cover (cropped, never distorted).

muted.description: Whether the area plays without sound; new areas start muted.

volume.description: Volume from 0 to 100 when not muted.

kind.description: MEDIA (plays what its program output selects) or CATALOG (shows a catalog view).

page_controlled.description: Whether the area changes content with the layout's pages.

catalog_id.nullMeaning: The area is a media area.

presentation.description: View presentation: list, table, menu or agenda.
presentation.nullMeaning: The area is a media area.

text_size.description: View text size, 24 to 200; text never shrinks below it.
text_size.nullMeaning: The area is a media area.

show_unavailable.description: Whether the view shows unavailable records as unavailable instead of hiding them.
show_unavailable.nullMeaning: The area is a media area.

page_seconds.description: Seconds each view page shows when the area is not page-controlled, 5 to 120.
page_seconds.nullMeaning: The area is a media area.

objects.layout_areas_company_id_id_key: Tenant key that view fields and page contents reference.
objects.layout_areas_key_key: Area keys are unique within a layout.
objects.layout_areas_company_id_layout_id_fkey: The layout belongs to the same company; areas are deleted with it.
objects.layout_areas_company_id_catalog_id_fkey: The viewed catalog belongs to the same company and cannot be deleted while a layout shows it.
objects.layout_areas_catalog_idx: Finds the layouts that show a catalog.
objects.layout_areas_name_trimmed: Names are trimmed and not empty.
objects.layout_areas_geometry: Rectangles are at least 40 units and within the larger canvas dimension; the API checks the layout's own canvas.
objects.layout_areas_fit: Media fit is contain or cover.
objects.layout_areas_view: Catalog areas, and only they, carry a complete view with a known presentation and bounded text size and paging.

layout_view_fields.description: One catalog field a view binds, in order, with its role: title, subtitle, price, image, detail or group.
layout_view_fields.lifecycle: Replaced with the whole definition on every save; deleted with its area.

company_id.description: Company that owns the layout (tenant key).

area_id.description: Catalog area whose view binds the field.

position.description: Zero-based order in the view, 0 to 7.

field_id.description: Bound catalog field; it cannot be deleted or archived while bound.

role.description: How the view shows the field: title, subtitle, price, image, detail or group.

objects.layout_view_fields_company_id_area_id_fk: The area belongs to the same company; bindings are deleted with it.
objects.layout_view_fields_company_id_field_id_f: The field belongs to the same company and cannot be deleted while bound.
objects.layout_view_fields_field_idx: Finds the layouts that bind a field.
objects.layout_view_fields_position_range: A view binds at most eight fields.
objects.layout_view_fields_role: Roles come from a closed set.

layout_pages.description: One coordinated page of a layout, with its duration.
layout_pages.lifecycle: Replaced with the whole definition on every save; deleted with the layout.

id.description: Backend-generated page UUID, new on every save.

company_id.description: Company that owns the layout (tenant key).

duration_seconds.description: How long the page shows, 1 to 600.

objects.layout_pages_company_id_id_key: Tenant key that page contents reference.
objects.layout_pages_position_key: One page per position in a layout.
objects.layout_pages_company_id_layout_id_fkey: The layout belongs to the same company; pages are deleted with it.
objects.layout_pages_position_range: A layout has at most 20 pages.

layout_page_contents.description: What one page-controlled area shows on one page: a media item, a view page or a group of the view.
layout_page_contents.lifecycle: Replaced with the whole definition on every save; deleted with its page or area.

company_id.description: Company that owns the layout (tenant key).

media_asset_id.description: Media item a media area shows on the page; it cannot be deleted while named.
media_asset_id.nullMeaning: The area is a catalog area.

view_page.description: View page, from 1, a catalog area shows on the page.
view_page.nullMeaning: The content is a media item or a group.

group_choice_id.description: Selection choice whose group a catalog area shows on the page.
group_choice_id.nullMeaning: The content is a media item or a view page.

objects.layout_page_contents_pkey: One content per page and area.
objects.layout_page_contents_company_id_page_id_: The page belongs to the same company; contents are deleted with it.
objects.layout_page_contents_company_id_area_id_: The area belongs to the same company; contents are deleted with it.
objects.layout_page_contents_company_id_media_as: The media item belongs to the same company and cannot be deleted while named.
objects.layout_page_contents_one_choice: Each content names exactly one media item, view page or group, with view pages from 1.

enums.PlaylistTransition: Transition between playlist items: CUT or FADE.
enums.LayoutOrientation: Layout canvas orientation: LANDSCAPE or PORTRAIT.
enums.LayoutAreaKind: Layout area kinds: MEDIA or CATALOG.
